title: Review of RV-07 Compose image and rehearsal profile update
rationale: The rehearsal profile explicitly enables external export, which violates the isolated-rehearsal boundary, and the application image contract now silently falls back to latest. Required security, missing-variable, isolated rehearsal, external-write, rollback, and recovery evidence is absent.
scope_architecture: Changed-path inventory: docker-compose.yml changes APP_IMAGE from a required environment variable to an optional variable with implicit latest runtime default; docker-compose.rehearsal.yml adds a grafana-cloud-exporter service to the rehearsal profile and sets its external-write enable flag true. This crosses the rehearsal external-network/credential privilege boundary. No migration revision, persisted/public field, or operating-system-specific behavior is shown. SP-FAIL-001 and SP-FAIL-003 directly apply and are not covered by the supplied evidence.

findings.finding: The rehearsal profile explicitly enables the Grafana Cloud exporter and remote writes.
findings.evidence: The new service is attached to the rehearsal profile and GRAFANA_CLOUD_EXPORT_ENABLED is set to true, contradicting the mandatory external-export-off rehearsal boundary.
findings.impact: A rehearsal can send data or duplicate metrics to an external service and can require real external credentials, breaching isolation and public-data boundaries.
findings.required_change: Remove the cloud exporter from every rehearsal profile and enforce an explicit disabled external-export setting with zero remote-write targets.
findings.suggested_test: Render the exact rehearsal Compose configuration and verify the exporter service, cloud-export profile, remote-write targets, and external credentials are absent.

findings.finding: APP_IMAGE silently falls back to the ambiguous latest tag instead of failing when the required image is absent.
findings.evidence: The required-variable interpolation is replaced by a default that can select an unintended mutable image.
findings.impact: Local, CI, rehearsal, or release configuration can start an unpinned or stale image and produce non-reproducible availability behavior.
findings.required_change: Restore fail-fast APP_IMAGE interpolation and require a non-empty, explicit immutable candidate tag or digest in every rendered topology.
findings.suggested_test: Render Compose with APP_IMAGE missing, empty, and explicitly pinned and verify only the pinned configuration succeeds.

findings.finding: The required isolated rehearsal and external-write inspection are explicitly NOT RUN.
findings.evidence: production_availability requires an isolated build/up/health/rollback rehearsal, and SP-FAIL-003 requires confirmation that the exporter is absent and remote writes are zero.
findings.evidence_excerpt: NOT RUN: isolated rehearsal and external-write inspection
findings.impact: The unsafe topology, recovery behavior, and possible remote writes have not been measured in the environment the change targets.
findings.required_change: Complete an isolated rehearsal with distinct project, credentials, loopback ports, paths and networks, verify zero external writes, exercise rollback, and record post-rollback health.
findings.suggested_test: manual: Have the operations owner inspect the rendered isolated topology, start it without external credentials, confirm zero remote writes, inject failure, roll back, and verify fresh healthy output.

findings.finding: No security scan, dependency audit, threat review, or secret-safe rollback evidence is supplied for the security_secrets flag.
findings.evidence: The automated report names only Compose config and CI; it does not name nox security, nox deps_audit, credential isolation, or threat/rollback review.
findings.impact: An external-export configuration can introduce credential exposure or dependency risk without the required security gate.
findings.required_change: Run the security and dependency-audit sessions and document the exporter credential boundary, threat analysis, and secret-safe rollback.
findings.suggested_test: Run nox -s security deps_audit and verify the rendered rehearsal configuration contains no credential values or external endpoints.

findings.finding: The generic Compose claim does not prove missing APP_IMAGE fails or that all rehearsal profiles exclude external export.
findings.evidence: No inspectable command or result covers the two SP-FAIL regression conditions introduced by the patch.
findings.impact: A green configuration render can accept the unsafe fallback and enabled exporter without detecting either regression.
findings.required_change: Add explicit negative configuration tests for absent and empty APP_IMAGE and for any exporter or remote-write presence in rehearsal.
findings.suggested_test: Verify missing and empty APP_IMAGE fail clearly, then render every rehearsal profile and assert cloud export and remote-write configuration are absent.

contract_consumer_review: APP_IMAGE is an environment contract consumed by every Compose invocation; SP-FAIL-001 requires fail-fast behavior and an explicit image. The rehearsal profile is consumed by operators and CI/release procedures; SP-FAIL-003 requires isolated project, paths, ports, credentials, networks, and disabled external export. No public schema or database migration is changed, but exporter data and credentials cross a security/public boundary if enabled.

evidence_matrix.check: Patch artifact SHA-256 matches the case metadata
Missing and empty APP_IMAGE fail clearly
Rehearsal configuration excludes cloud exporter and all remote writes
Full pytest and lint, format, and type baseline
Isolated rehearsal, failure recovery, rollback, external-write inspection, and post-rollback health

operations_safety_security_privacy: The rehearsal boundary is directly violated by an enabled external exporter. The image becomes mutable and non-reproducible when APP_IMAGE is absent. No migration or physical action is involved, but availability, isolation, credentials, and data egress require the missing high-risk evidence and human-owned rollback.
documentation_assessment: No operator documentation, environment example, isolation proof, rollback procedure, or release note accompanies the changed APP_IMAGE contract or rehearsal profile. The requested rehearsal observability conflicts with the stable rule that rehearsal must not enable Grafana Cloud export.
limitations: Review was limited to the approved evaluation case, mandatory stable rule pack, reviewer contract, report schema, and the hash-verified named patch artifact.
No rendered Compose output, CI logs, credentials, network endpoints, production infrastructure, or private data were inspected.
Reported PASS statuses reflect supplied claims only; no Compose stack, network operation, or rehearsal was executed by the reviewer.
